# How TikTok for Restaurants Can Shake up Your Marketing Strategy

![tiktok for restaurants](https://www.gloriafood.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/tik-tok-970x424.png)

*   [Social Media Tips for Restaurants](https://www.gloriafood.com/category/social-media-tips-for-restaurants)

27 Jan 2021Updated: 27 Nov 2025by [Laura-Andreea Voicu](https://www.gloriafood.com/author/laura-voicu)

TikTok for Restaurants 101

*   1.[What You Need to Know About TikTok](https://www.gloriafood.com/tiktok-for-restaurants#what)
*   2.[What is TikTok Marketing?](https://www.gloriafood.com/tiktok-for-restaurants#whatis)
*   3.[TikTok and Marketing: Why You Need It for Your Restaurant](https://www.gloriafood.com/tiktok-for-restaurants#why)
*   4.[How to Use TikTok for Restaurants: 5 Tips & Ideas](https://www.gloriafood.com/tiktok-for-restaurants#how)

*   [Create a hashtag challenge](https://www.gloriafood.com/tiktok-for-restaurants#challenge)
*   [Come up with unique campaigns](https://www.gloriafood.com/tiktok-for-restaurants#campaigns)
*   [Partner up with micro-influencers for skits and fun challenges](https://www.gloriafood.com/tiktok-for-restaurants#influencers)
*   [Share behind the scenes clips and secret recipes](https://www.gloriafood.com/tiktok-for-restaurants#bts)
*   [Sample TikTok ads to find the best for your restaurant](https://www.gloriafood.com/tiktok-for-restaurants#ads)

*   5.[More Inspiration: 3 Successful Food Brands on TikTok](https://www.gloriafood.com/tiktok-for-restaurants#brands)

*   [Chipotle](https://www.gloriafood.com/tiktok-for-restaurants#chipotle)
*   [Dunkin’](https://www.gloriafood.com/tiktok-for-restaurants#dunkin)
*   [Burger King](https://www.gloriafood.com/tiktok-for-restaurants#burgerking)

*   6.[Bottom Line](https://www.gloriafood.com/tiktok-for-restaurants#bottom)

Have you mastered all other social media platforms and are looking for a new challenge in terms of restaurant marketing? Then look no further than TikTok for restaurants.

TikTok has acquired more than [1.7 billion monthly active users](https://viralyft.com/blog/tiktok-statistics) globally. This rising star can help you tap into a new market and turn TikTok users into loyal customers. Let’s see how you can do that and what to pay attention to when creating a TikTok marketing strategy.

## What You Need to Know About TikTok

This relatively new social media platform has taken the world by storm and continues to do so as more people and brands alike are signing up. Due to its authentic way of consuming content, TikTok has won over [1.4](https://influencity.com/resources/studies/tiktok-influencer-marketing-study-statistics/) billion people worldwide (and counting). While the target demographic and most avid consumers are gen Zers, people of all ages can enjoy this app – and they do.

_**You might be interested** in reading more social media statistics for restaurants. [Download](https://www.gloriafood.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/07/Social-media-for-restaurants-stats-1.pdf) our restaurant social media stats infographic._

So, how does TikTok work exactly? This is an app that allows you to create short videos (no more than 60 seconds), customize them with effects and filters, and share them with the world. As a restaurateur, TikTok can be a great place to find brand ambassadors that are not necessarily well-established social media influencers.

Young users on TikTok like to watch videos, but they also like to create them. They can end up representing your brand if they like your food and presence on the platform, and bringing your restaurant to more people’s attention.

_**Related: [\[Infographic\] Video Marketing for Restaurants: How to Stand out with Unique Video Content](https://www.gloriafood.com/video-marketing-for-restaurants)**_

## What is TikTok Marketing?

TikTok marketing is the process of promoting your brand, products, and services to customers on TikTok by posting content, doing popular challenges, using hashtags, collaborating with TikTok influencers, and communicating with your followers.

## TikTok and Marketing: Why You Need It for Your Restaurant

Especially now, when most interaction between a brand and its customers is done online, businesses have to take advantage of every relevant social media platform. If TikTok is on the rise, your restaurant should be on it. Here are some good reasons why:

1.  **Can help you get new customers:** If you get people to notice your videos by posting engaging content, you should also add a link to your website or online ordering page on your profile to increase conversions.
2.  **Will connect you with locals:** TikTok uses an algorithm that prioritizes what videos to show users based on their location. So, your videos will probably be seen by potential customers in your area.
3.  **Delivers high engagement:** As opposed to other social media platforms, TikTok’s algorithm makes it easier for more people to see your videos and engage with them. And the best part? You don’t need to have a lot of followers to have your content go viral.
4.  **Features micro-influencers you can partner up with:** Another way to reach a local audience is to find an influencer that has a couple of thousands of followers but is popular within a small community. If you want to target a specific location, find an authentic influencer that people in the area love and propose a partnership.
5.  **Offers the possibility of advertising on the platform with less competition:** This is all about being an early bird and taking advantage of this opportunity before a lot of brands start advertising on TikTok and the competition increases. Right now, you can still get more reach and engagement on your ads on TikTok than on other platforms.

## How to Use TikTok for Restaurants: 5 Tips & Ideas

TikTok is evolving as we speak, and new opportunities for businesses to advertise their products will undoubtedly show up. For now, these TikTok ideas for restaurants aim to help you get more engagement on the platform and send some of those users to your website.

### 1\. Create a hashtag challenge

Hashtag challenges are one of the most popular activities on TikTok. They truly bring the entire community together, from young people to seniors.

You too can create a hashtag challenge by simply uploading a video of yourself (or one of your staff members) doing the challenge and including its name in a hashtag, like Jimmy Fallon did with [#tumbleweedchallenge](https://twitter.com/hashtag/tumbleweedchallenge?src=hash), which has become insanely popular.
